notes: This project prefers small patches. Do not deploy, force-push, or edit lockfiles unless the user asks.

routes.implement: The user wants files, configuration, or behavior changed.
routes.explain: The user wants an answer or walkthrough and did not ask for edits.
routes.review: The user wants findings or a critique and did not ask to apply fixes.
routes.plan: The user wants an approach before any edits.
routes.refuse: The user wants credential theft, unauthorized access, sabotage, or to bypass written project policy.
